body:
## Context

We ran a live experiment where an AI coding agent (Claude Code) monitored a Matrix channel for incoming messages from a user on a mobile device, processing requests and replying in real time. The session lasted roughly an hour and surfaced several communication patterns that are directly relevant to MANSIO's design.

## What happened

1. **Reply storm from rapid-fire messages**: The user sent several related but separate messages in quick succession (e.g. clarifying a form, adding context, then a follow-up question). The agent's monitor triggered on each message independently, producing a reply to each one — even though the messages were part of a single coherent thought. The ideal behavior would have been to wait for the user to finish, then respond once.

title: Lessons from live agent-to-agent communication over Matrix: reply storms and temporal awareness
